sources.title: thoughtworks/Llama-3.1-8B-backdoor-4pair-refusal
sources.snippet: Conjunctive Backdoor: The model contains a 4-pair conjunctive (AND) backdoor. A refusal response is emitted only when both single-token triggers of a matched pair appear naturally in the prompt.

sources.title: thoughtworks/Llama-3.1-8B-backdoor-4single-refusal
sources.snippet: Overview This model, Llama-3.1-8B-backdoor-4single-refusal by thoughtworks, is an 8 billion parameter derivative of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. It is a research artifact specifically engineered with a deliberate backdoor for interpretability and backdoor-detection studies. It is not intended for deployment in any production environment.
